title: Distributionally Robust Optimization via Targeted Integral Probability Metrics for General Data Processes
summary: Distributionally robust optimization (DRO) provides a principled framework for decision-making under distributional uncertainty. Classical data-driven DRO frameworks typically construct ambiguity sets from distributional information, such as moment constraints, divergence neighborhoods, or Wasserstein balls, specified before the downstream loss is considered. We propose a task-aware DRO framework based on targeted integral probability metrics.
